text.tspan: Estimated number of malaria cases World, 2000 to 2024
The World Health Organization publishes estimates of the total number of malaria cases, based on confirmed
and suspected cases submitted by national programs, and taking underreporting into account.

tspan.tspan: World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory (2026)
